build_step3p5_causal_lm: build a Step3p5ForCausalLM model with config and quantization config for causal language modeling
load_step3p5_weights: load Step3p5ForCausalLM weights from an iterable of name-tensor pairs with support for MTP nextn layers
create_step3p5_decoder_layer: create a Step3p5DecoderLayer with attention, MoE or dense MLP, and layer scatter modes
build_step3p5_attention: build a Step3p5Attention module with QKV projection, rotary embeddings, and RadixAttention
create_step3p5_moe_mlp: create a Step3p5MoEMLP with top-k routing, expert dispatch, and fused MoE computation
